name: codegraph
description: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt when a .codegraph directory exists and exposes 21 CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.

interface.shortDescription: Symbols, call chains and impact queries on a local index
interface.longDescription: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt at SessionStart (only when `.codegraph/` exists). Exposes 21 of codegraph's 23 CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.
defaultPrompt: Index this repository with /codegraph-init so I can answer code questions via CodeGraph
Find callers of the function I just changed
Show me what would be affected if I change <symbol>
Run /codegraph-status so I can see if the index is stale
defaultPromptZhCn: 用 /codegraph-init 索引此仓库，我就能通过 CodeGraph 回答代码问题
找出我刚改的那个函数的所有调用方
看看如果改 <symbol> 会影响哪些代码
跑一下 /codegraph-status，看索引是否过期
